overall: Violation found: a Board member's email to a quorum expressing an opinion on a Board matter was improper deliberation. Board ordered to comply going forward and release the June 5, 2025 emails within 30 days.

allegations.summary: Alleged that a quorum of the three-member Board deliberated via email outside a properly posted meeting, after a June 5, 2025 email exchange.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by deliberating among a quorum via email.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law's requirements.
Disclose publicly, within thirty (30) days of the letter date, the June 5, 2025 emails sent by Mr. Stocker.
remedy_passage: In addition, we order the Board to disclose, within thirty (30) days of the date of this letter, the June 5, 2025, emails.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
